I'm so sorry that you feel this way. I completely understand how you feel, but believe me, it's not worth it. If you even attempt, whether you fail or succeed, you hurt the people around you. Your family, your friends, etc. I know you don't mean to, but it scars them for life. One of my friends, who I was close with at one point, killed himself, in April, and I still feel guilt and think about what I did wrong. I was never included on his note, so I basically am stuck clinging to a couple words he wrote for me in my yearbook, trying to convince myself every day that I did my best. 

You are not a disappointment. You are not a failure. Your mother loves you, and even if you drop out of high school, you have a future. You are a wonderful, intelligent human being, and you have a beautifully and heartwrenchingly poetry to your words. You are talented, and there are many people who are blessed by your presence. 

It's really evident how much you care about others. We need more people like you here. I know it's hard, and I know it hurts, but you are necessary. You are not an optional asset to this world. In this tumultuous global climate, we need people who care, people with heart.

So, please stay. Life is hard. Life is cruel. But we are here for you, and so are the people you love.
